jobs.title: Sr Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Ball, integrity and trust are the foundation of who we are. Guided by our core values —"We Care. We Work. We Win.”— we create a culture where every voice matters and every idea drives progress.

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Create a new future. Apply Today.

Your Opportunity to Make an Impact

At Ball, the Sr Project Manager plays a critical role in leading complex capital and manufacturing projects from planning through implementation. Working cross-functionally with engineering, operations, finance, and plant teams, this role ensures projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget while supporting operational excellence and business growth.

How You'll Make a Difference

Establish, monitor, and revise project schedules using critical path methodologies to achieve project objectives.
Lead the planning and implementation of assigned projects, ensuring alignment with budget, timeline, and operational requirements.
Coordinate feasibility studies and evaluate project options in collaboration with key stakeholders across the business.
Prepare AFEs and requisitions with detailed scopes of work, accurate cost estimates, and clear project justifications.
Manage project budgets and forecasting activities while maintaining accurate project accounting records.
Provide regular project status updates covering progress, costs, risks, issues, and schedule performance.
Build, lead, and influence cross-functional project teams, including engineering, manufacturing, and external partners.
Ensure engineering documentation, work orders, and change controls comply with approved standards and project requirements.
Support a safe work environment by adhering to all company safety policies and procedures.
Leverage project management and business systems to maintain accountability, communication, and project visibility.

What Helps You Thrive In This Role

University degree or equivalent education in Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a manufacturing environment.
Minimum of 3 years of experience leading project implementation activities.
Minimum of 2 years of experience leading others to achieve common goals.
Strong understanding of manufacturing equipment and production processes.
Excellent organizational, self-motivation, and action-oriented problem-solving skills.
Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders.
Working knowledge of project management principles, including scope definition, scheduling, monitoring, and risk management.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and business systems such as Coupa, JDE, and project scheduling tools.
Financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and project cost control.

Sr Project Manager must possess excellent relationship buidling and influencing skills since they will lead people that are outside their direct reporting line. While the regular working cycle of this position is usually five days on (Monday-Friday), this job may include working weekends (Saturday and Sunday). Working hours may vary as specified by management and/or as required by project needs. Incumbent must be able to work overtime on a regular basis and/or be on call as directed by management.

Work Environment: This role supports central functions and offers flexible work arrangements including hybrid or fully remote options, subject to role requirements and manager approval.

Hiring Range: 671250- 895000 SEK gross per year - The final salary will be determined based on the candidate’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and market benchmarks. Depending on these factors, the actual offer may fall above or below the posted range.

Incentive Plan
: The position is eligible for a bonus under the bonus system communicated by the company at each occasion.

Comprehensive Benefits Package:
For specific details and eligibility see Teknikavtalet Unionen, Ledarna och Sveriges ingengörer. Pension plan via Collectum. Life insurance, insurance for work accident long-term sick leave, parental leave and Insurance transition support Ball offer employees Friskvårdsbidrag, Gruppförsäkring Skandia, lunch Benefit and employee assistance program.

The management team is also offered quick access to healthcare Access Deductible.

The salary range is provided for candidates from PRIMARY LOCATION COUNTRY. For other locations, information regarding salary will be shared during the recruitment process.

If you have a disability and/or long-term health condition that impacts your ability to access any of the information outlined in the job application process, please do not hesitate in letting us know, so that we can endeavour to provide it you in the most accessible format. Please email jobs.emea@ball.com with your access request, and somebody will respond to you within 3 business days.

Ball Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, faith, ability, or orientation. Our products range from infinitely recyclable aluminium cans, cups to aerosol bottles solutions that enable our customers to contribute to a better world.

Each of us has a deep commitment to diversity and inclusion which is the foundation of our culture of belonging. Everyone at Ball is making a difference by doing what we love. Because what we create may change, but what we will always make is a difference.

No agencies please.

jobs.title: Business Analyst /Project Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
About the Company

LendSure Mortgage Corp. is a fast-growing wholesale mortgage lender specializing in Non-QM loan solutions. The company helps mortgage originators grow their businesses by providing financing options for borrowers who do not meet conventional conforming loan guidelines.

LendSure is committed to attracting and retaining talent across the United States, offering competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for professional growth.

About the Role

LendSure Mortgage Corp. is seeking a Senior Business Analyst / Project Manager to serve as the primary liaison between business teams, including Sales and Operations, and the internal technical development team responsible for the Encompass loan origination system (LOS).

This role will translate business and operational needs into clear technical requirements, identify opportunities to improve workflows, prioritize system enhancements, and manage projects from initial planning through implementation. The position will also support integrations between Encompass and other platforms, including the company's CRM, broker portal, and income analysis tools.

The ideal candidate understands both mortgage lending operations and technical systems, can anticipate the downstream impact of proposed changes, and is capable of driving projects to completion while managing competing priorities and limited resources.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the internal Encompass development team.
Partner with Sales, Operations, and other departments to understand business processes, challenges, and system requirements.
Gather, analyze, document, and refine business and functional requirements for Encompass enhancements, integrations, workflow changes, and related technology initiatives.
Translate business requirements into user stories, technical specifications, process flows, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
Evaluate enhancement requests to identify dependencies, risks, downstream impacts, and opportunities to simplify existing processes.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve data quality, and increase efficiency across Encompass workflows.
Manage projects and system initiatives from discovery and planning through development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation review.
Work with developers and technical resources, including third-party vendors, to clarify requirements and resolve questions throughout the development lifecycle.
Develop a strong understanding of LendSure's products, policies, and operational processes, including workflows that accommodate exceptions.
Track, document, and report progress across multiple ongoing projects.
Help establish consistent standards for requirements, change management, testing, documentation, and implementation for Encompass-related initiatives.
Coordinate project priorities, timelines, deliverables, and dependencies across teams.
Maintain project plans, requirements documentation, issue logs, decision records, and other project materials.
Communicate project status, risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support change management activities before and after system deployments.
Organize and support user acceptance testing, including preparing test scenarios and validating completed functionality against business requirements.
Troubleshoot Encompass issues and conduct root-cause analysis.
Coordinate system rollouts and announcements with the corporate training team.
Prepare release notes and schedule and deliver demonstrations for the training team.

Required Qualifications

At least 5 years of experience working with Encompass in a technical, analytical, business systems, administrative, development, or implementation capacity is strongly preferred.
Significant experience in business analysis, project management, systems analysis, product ownership, or a similar role.
Strong understanding of mortgage lending workflows and the loan origination lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to gather complex business requirements and translate them into clear, detailed technical and functional specifications.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to assess how system changes affect multiple workflows, teams, and processes.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, priorities, and stakeholder groups.
Strong verbal communication and technical writing skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with executives, business users, operations teams, and technical personnel.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Experience with user acceptance testing, software releases, change management, and software development lifecycles.
Ability to work independently while collaborating with a distributed team.

Preferred Qualifications

Deep knowledge of the Encompass loan origination system, including configuration, business rules, workflows, personas, fields, forms, integrations, reporting, or related development.
Experience in wholesale or Non-QM mortgage lending.
Experience analyzing and redesigning mortgage operations workflows.
Familiarity with APIs, system integrations, data mapping, databases, and related technical concepts.
Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or similar development environments.
Experience with project management and requirements-management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar platforms.

Compensation & Benefits

Annual salary range of $75,000–$100,000.
Discretionary quarterly bonus.
Full salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth within the company.

Work Arrangement & Location

Permanent, full-time position.
Remote work is available within the United States.
LendSure's process-improvement and project management team, along with its executive team, is based at the company's headquarters in San Diego, California.
Candidates able to work onsite in San Diego on a regular or periodic basis are preferred.
Compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, location, and ability to work from the San Diego office.

Employment Eligibility

LendSure Mortgage Corp. participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with information from employees' Form I-9 to confirm authorization to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Project Manager - settore machinery (usati e revamping)
jobs.description:
Questa è un’interessante opportunità per entrare a far parte di una prestigiosa realtà italiana operante nel settore automazione industriale, tra i principali player mondiali nel suo settore. La figura sarà il principale punto di riferimento per il Cliente e si interfaccerà con molteplici funzioni interne – commerciale, sviluppo prodotto, acquisti, collaudo, assistenza e subsidiaries estere, con l’obiettivo di presidiare i progetti assegnati e garantirne la realizzazione, nel rispetto dei tempi, costi e qualità.

Responsabilità

La risorsa selezionata riporterà al Program Manager di riferimento (usati e revamping) e, all’interno di un’organizzazione a matrice debole, avrà l’obiettivo di gestire le commesse assegnate e coordinare le relative attività cross- funzionali, dalla presa in carico dell’ordine fino all’accettazione della macchina da parte del cliente.

Nello specifico, sarà responsabile delle seguenti attività:

Raccogliere l’esigenza del Cliente relativamente a modifiche / implementazioni / revamping e ricambi relativi a macchine usate
Redigere le offerte commerciali
Gestire e presidiare lo sviluppo dei progetti assegnati (circa 80 progetti / anno), seguendone l’intero ciclo e assicurandone rispetto delle tempistiche e profittabilità
Supportare il Cliente durante il progetto, con aggiornamento costante sul relativo stato di avanzamento, gestione di modifiche, gestione di eventuali reclami, gestione dei pagamenti, con il coinvolgimento dei dipartimenti interni specializzati (ufficio tecnico, acquisti, produzione, collaudo, assistenza tecnica)
Dialogare con le consociate estere, garantendo la corretta applicazione dei listini e dei rincari
Partecipare a fiere ed eventi
Operare con elevata autonomia decisionale, rapidità e capacità negoziale.

Profilo

Saranno valutate per l’iter le sole candidature in possesso dei seguenti requisiti:

Percorso di studi tecnico o ingegneristico
Esperienza pregressa in ruoli di gestione progetti o tecnico-commerciali in contesti a forte caratterizzazione tecnica, preferibilmente in aziende costruttrici di macchinari industriali o di prodotti ad elevata complessità
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese
Disponibilità a trasferte in Italia e nel mondo (per circa il 15-20% del tempo)
Buona dimestichezza con strumenti software per la gestione di progetti e con i più diffusi CRM (preferibile conoscenza di Salesforce).

Completano il profilo ricercato: capacità di pianificazione, spiccate capacità relazionali e negoziali, orientamento al cliente e all'obiettivo, autonomia decisionale, capacità di presidiare i progetti dal punto di vista del tempo e della qualità del risultato, capacità di fidelizzare il cliente e consolidare la relazione nel tempo.

L’azienda offre un contesto strutturato con un impianto formativo d’eccellenza, una cultura aziendale orientata al benessere dei dipendenti (smart working, flessibilità, ecc.) e buone prospettive di crescita in un ambiente sfidante e tecnologicamente stimolante.

jobs.description:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Infection Prevention Business Project Manager to join our Infection Prevention (IP) team. This is an exciting opportunity to lead on high-impact programmes that support patient safety, quality improvement, and organisational performance.

The post holder will lead and deliver complex projects and programmes across the Infection Prevention service, working collaboratively with clinical, operational and managerial teams. You will play a key role in shaping service development, driving innovation, and ensuring effective implementation of IP strategies aligned with organisational and national priorities.

The ability to speak Welsh is desirable for this post; Welsh and/or English speakers are equally welcome to apply.

Main duties of the job

Lead the planning, delivery, and evaluation of complex IPC projects and programmes
Analyse performance, capacity, and demand data to inform decision-making and service improvements
Develop and implement new models of working to enhance infection prevention practices
Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to support integrated service delivery
Contribute to policy development and ensure effective implementation across services
Monitor project outcomes, risks, and benefits, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines and resources
Support service improvement initiatives

Working for our organisation

If you relish a challenge, have a passion to help others or simply fancy a fresh start, then Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board (BCUHB) North Wales, has all the right ingredients. The largest health organisation in Wales, providing a full range of primary, community, mental health, acute and elective hospital services for a population of around 700,000, across North Wales . Join our team and get the support you need, in line with our Organisational Values and ‘Proud to Lead’ competence framework.

Enjoy being part of working with engaged leadership at all levels, and be assured we are committed to promoting equality and diversity, and are proud to welcome applicants under the “Disability Confident Employer” scheme.

Please check your email account regularly. Successful applicants will receive all recruitment related correspondence via the email account registered on the application form.

Applications may be submitted in Welsh. Applications submitted in Welsh will not be treated less favourably than an application submitted in English.

Detailed Job Description And Main Responsibilities

The Infection Prevention Business and Project Manager provides specialist business, programme, and project management to support the Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) agenda.

The post holder will be required to plan, coordinate, and deliver a range of IPC‑related programmes, projects, audits, campaigns, and improvement activities that support the prevention, surveillance, and reduction of healthcare‑associated infections (HCAIs).

The role supports IPC clinical leadership and senior managers by ensuring IPC workstreams are effectively governed, delivered, monitored, and reported, contributing to patient safety, regulatory assurance, and continuous quality improvement.

The post holder will operate with a high degree of autonomy within agreed organisational priorities, governance frameworks, and escalation processes.

Person specification

Qualifications

Essential criteria

Degree or equivalent of knowledge
ILM Management level 4 or equivalent
Current knowledge of project management and it application

Desirable criteria

Evidence of managing and leading complex projects
Evidence of dealing with complex data and analysis

Significant experience of working in NHS /social care or voluntary sector
Experience of monitoring budget control, contract negotiation, procurement and financial procedures
Participation in significant change management services and process re- engineering

Desirable criteria

Proven ability to successfully manage complex/significant services
Experience of working within an agreed structure, and managing complex change within.

Skills And Attributes

Essential criteria

Ability to work on own initiative and organise/prioritise own workload and that of the team to operate effectively
Ability to communicate verbally with all levels of the organisation and able and willing to share information.
Proven ability to analyse and appropriately present complex information so that it is easy to understand

Desirable criteria

Spoken or written Welsh language
Leadership/motivational skills

The NSO Project Manager partners closely with the Business Management Operations (BMO) team, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, and Configuration Management organizations to manage project execution, mitigate risk, resolve issues, and ensure alignment between customer requirements and factory readiness. The role requires strong project management skills, exceptional organizational abilities, and the capacity to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Own end-to-end execution of assigned NSO projects from order release through shipment.

Support shipment readiness activities, including final test coordination, documentation reviews, and production release requirements.
Maintain accurate project documentation, action-item tracking, schedule status, and project metrics.
Provide timely status updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans to stakeholders and leadership.
Identify and implement process improvements that enhance NSO execution efficiency, predictability, and customer delivery performance.

This role involves interacting with Global teams such as IAM, Information Security, and Application Managers, as well as local teams like the Banamex TSA office and Banamex users. The analyst is also responsible for the end-to-end follow-up and resolution of automatic alerts for unauthorized access. Additionally, this position oversees maintaining the central repository with all supporting documentation in compliance with corporate standards and TSA Mexico office guidelines, and preparing materials for review sessions, forums, CAP closures, and audit deliverables.

Key Responsibilities:

Reporting and Analysis:
Generate and distribute periodic reports on the entitlements of Banamex users to global applications outside the TSA scope.
Download, process, and analyze daily alert reports, identify new hires, terminations, and user reactivations, and keeping records updated in SharePoint.
Address information requests from different teams regarding the number of users per application, both within and outside the TSA. Monitor key metrics related to access removal activities and unauthorized access remediation.

Operational Coordination and Support:
Coordinate with the Cybersecurity team for application reviews, manage the list of applications requiring user access removal activities, and obtain the necessary approvals from App Managers.
Actively participate in recurring meetings with the Banamex TSA team to track mass removals and be responsible for documenting action items and meeting minutes.
Investigate and follow up on special alert cases where a user cannot be removed, collaborating with Cybersecurity and TSA offices for resolution.

Collaborate with global and local stakeholders to ensure timely execution of access remediation activities.
Process Improvement and Documentation:
Design, develop and enhance dashboards to monitor the progress of user removals managed through the alert treatment process, identify opportunities to improve reporting, monitoring, documentation, and operational processes. Create and maintain the central repository of supporting evidence in accordance with corporate standards and TSA guidelines.
Team Collaboration and Support:
Serve as backup for team members, providing support and ensuring continuity of critical processes and deliverables.

Risk Management and Compliance:
Ensure compliance with corporate policies and standards.

Support audit requests, process reviews, and CAP closure activities through accurate documentation and evidence management.

Experience: 3 to 5+ years of experience in operations support, administration, or project coordination roles, preferably within the banking or financial services sector.
Technical Skills:
Strong organizational, analytical, and document management skills.
Experience using collaboration and tracking tools such as SharePoint, JIRA, MS Project, or similar platforms.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and tracking.
Knowledge in AI tools.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to analyze issues, identify root causes, and propose solutions.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
Strong stakeholder management and follow-up skills.

Desirable: Familiarity with Transition Service Agreement (TSA) structures or divestiture environments, access management processes, or information security controls.

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Expand your horizons, advance your career, and contribute to a secure future for generations. Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector invites you to bring your pioneering spirit to our collaborative teams. As an Industrial Security Analyst/Project Manager – Level 3 or Level 4
located in Dulles, VA
, you’ll be a linchpin in missions of paramount importance, defining the art of the possible from day one. This position is 100% onsite and cannot accommodate telecommute work.

The Industrial Security Analyst/Project Manager will be responsible for supporting the Space Systems Sector Eastern Region in all aspects of Physical Security, with a focus on design, construction, renovation, and accreditation of Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and Special Access Program Facilities (SAPFs).

Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

Ensure NG Space Sector secure areas meet all applicable DoD and IC standards for processing, handling, and storing Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and Special Access Programs (SAP) prior to formal accreditation as a SCIF or SAPF.
Ensure assigned security projects and programs comply with physical, TEMPEST, and other applicable security governance (e.g., IC Directives, DoD directives/instructions/manuals, national security standards, interim guidance, and Executive Orders governing physical, industrial, and information security).
Apply and interpret requirements from ICD 705 Tech Spec, CNSS publications, and related guidance; provide general TEMPEST concepts and requirements to stakeholders.
Manage and oversee the SCIF/SAPF area lifecycle from concept planning and design through construction and accreditation/certification.
Review and provide input on physical security and TEMPEST aspects of Design Intent Drawings (DIDs) and Construction Drawings (CDs).
Provide oversight of initial alarm installation and testing in accordance with applicable DoD and IC policy requirements.
Serve as a technical expert on physical security for secure facilities, advising program and site leadership on risk and compliance impacts.

Health Policy

Job Summary:

The Department of Health Policy is seeking qualified health policy data analyst candidates to provide support for complex quantitative research projects in health policy, public health, or related disciplines under occasional faculty guidance. This position utilizes intermediate level research skills to perform a variety of quantitative research activities including data management, analysis of quantitative data, and report preparation.

The ideal candidate will work well with multiple faculty members and projects simultaneously, be self-directed, think critically about complex data, proactively identify and resolve problems, and complete assignments in a timely manner. Familiarity with administrative healthcare claims data is requested, experience with T-MSIS analytic files in particular is desired.

In addition to creating analytic datasets from dissimilar data sources, the responsibilities of this position will include quantitative and written data analysis on issues of current policy interest, including health reform, Medicare/Medicaid spending and utilization patterns, health information technology, population health, and health care disparities. Examples of projects may include:

Analyzing trends in health care expenditures for Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries
Evaluating options for improving the value of care delivered to patients in diverse settings
Comparing patient clinical outcomes using healthcare claims linked with other data sources.

This position requires a Master's degree, or equivalent work experience.

You will enjoy a hybrid work schedule Monday-Friday, standard daytime business hours. You will need to report to our office at 2525 West End Ave. a couple of times a week.

DEPARTMENT SUMMARY:

The Department of Health Policy at Vanderbilt University Medical Center is a large and welcoming group of health policy faculty and staff who have broad experiences and backgrounds and conducting world-class health services research. The Department's collective goal is to inform health policy solutions and positively impact numerous areas of public health. The Department builds on a history of strong collaborative relationships with the Tennessee Department of Health, Tenncare, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and other local, state, national and global policy makers. For more information, please visit https://www.vumc.org/health-policy/welcome-health-policy.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Management
Responsible for cleaning, validating, and managing large and/or complex datasets, including administrative healthcare claims, and ensuring data quality and accuracy throughout cohort creation and analysis
Integrates and cross-validates data from different sources with differing structures and formats
Maintains detailed documentation of data management and programming codes
Ensures the integrity and security of data
Performs complex data linkages across data sources with different structures
Independently identifies and resolves data and programming issues
Health Policy Data Analysis
Uses advanced statistical and data programming skills to manage and analyze data (e.g., SAS, Stata, R)
Conducts, summarizes, and interprets complex analyses, including weighted and hierarchical analyses, time-to-event analyses, causal analyses, mediation analyses, and analyses of treatment-effects heterogeneity
Identifies, validates, extracts, and formats data for statistical analysis following project-specific parameters
Able to create, modify, and run queries and produce reports
Creates complex charts, graphs, and tables to summarize analysis results
Expertise in data modeling and understands relationships between data items
Critically evaluates and understands results and troubleshoots discrepancies
Project Management and Presentation
Uses intermediate quantitative research methods skills to participate in the design, coordination and conduct of research projects
Prepares materials and drafts technical sections of presentations and written documents
Able to prepare effective presentations in content and function
Fosters collaboration between team members, both internal and external to the department

Minimum Qualifications:

This position requires master’s degree and two years of related experience. A degree in economics, statistics, engineering, public policy, or another field with quantitative coursework is strongly preferred.

Preferred qualities and skills:

Expertise with Stata, SAS, or R
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong quantitative, statistical and data analysis skills
Strong analytic and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently identify and resolve programming issues
Ability to critically evaluate data structures, analyses, and results without relying solely on automated programming tools
Experience working with longitudinal administrative healthcare claims data
Experience combining dissimilar data to create analytic datasets
Knowledge of health policy issues
Self-starter with good time management, initiative, and professional work style

A current resume and cover letter must be included/uploaded in your online application to be eligible for consideration.

This is a full-time position.

Salary is dependent upon education and experience.

Background screens will be performed, and education will be verified prior to employment. Please be prepared to provide required information and/or documentation.

Coordinate documentation updates associated with technical and operational changes.

About the Company

LendSure Mortgage Corp. is a fast-growing wholesale mortgage lender specializing in Non-QM loan solutions. The company helps mortgage originators grow their businesses by providing financing options for borrowers who do not meet conventional conforming loan guidelines.

LendSure is committed to attracting and retaining talent across the United States, offering competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for professional growth.

About the Role

LendSure Mortgage Corp. is seeking a Senior Business Analyst / Project Manager to serve as the primary liaison between business teams, including Sales and Operations, and the internal technical development team responsible for the Encompass loan origination system (LOS).

This role will translate business and operational needs into clear technical requirements, identify opportunities to improve workflows, prioritize system enhancements, and manage projects from initial planning through implementation. The position will also support integrations between Encompass and other platforms, including the company's CRM, broker portal, and income analysis tools.

The ideal candidate understands both mortgage lending operations and technical systems, can anticipate the downstream impact of proposed changes, and is capable of driving projects to completion while managing competing priorities and limited resources.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the internal Encompass development team.
Partner with Sales, Operations, and other departments to understand business processes, challenges, and system requirements.
Gather, analyze, document, and refine business and functional requirements for Encompass enhancements, integrations, workflow changes, and related technology initiatives.
Translate business requirements into user stories, technical specifications, process flows, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
Evaluate enhancement requests to identify dependencies, risks, downstream impacts, and opportunities to simplify existing processes.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve data quality, and increase efficiency across Encompass workflows.
Manage projects and system initiatives from discovery and planning through development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation review.
Work with developers and technical resources, including third-party vendors, to clarify requirements and resolve questions throughout the development lifecycle.
Develop a strong understanding of LendSure's products, policies, and operational processes, including workflows that accommodate exceptions.
Track, document, and report progress across multiple ongoing projects.
Help establish consistent standards for requirements, change management, testing, documentation, and implementation for Encompass-related initiatives.
Coordinate project priorities, timelines, deliverables, and dependencies across teams.
Maintain project plans, requirements documentation, issue logs, decision records, and other project materials.
Communicate project status, risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support change management activities before and after system deployments.
Organize and support user acceptance testing, including preparing test scenarios and validating completed functionality against business requirements.
Troubleshoot Encompass issues and conduct root-cause analysis.
Coordinate system rollouts and announcements with the corporate training team.
Prepare release notes and schedule and deliver demonstrations for the training team.

Required Qualifications

At least 5 years of experience working with Encompass in a technical, analytical, business systems, administrative, development, or implementation capacity is strongly preferred.
Significant experience in business analysis, project management, systems analysis, product ownership, or a similar role.
Strong understanding of mortgage lending workflows and the loan origination lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to gather complex business requirements and translate them into clear, detailed technical and functional specifications.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to assess how system changes affect multiple workflows, teams, and processes.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, priorities, and stakeholder groups.
Strong verbal communication and technical writing skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with executives, business users, operations teams, and technical personnel.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Experience with user acceptance testing, software releases, change management, and software development lifecycles.
Ability to work independently while collaborating with a distributed team.

Preferred Qualifications

Deep knowledge of the Encompass loan origination system, including configuration, business rules, workflows, personas, fields, forms, integrations, reporting, or related development.
Experience in wholesale or Non-QM mortgage lending.
Experience analyzing and redesigning mortgage operations workflows.
Familiarity with APIs, system integrations, data mapping, databases, and related technical concepts.
Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or similar development environments.
Experience with project management and requirements-management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar platforms.

Compensation & Benefits

Annual salary range of $75,000–$100,000.
Discretionary quarterly bonus.
Full salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth within the company.

Permanent, full-time position.

LGT Bank was built around a clear vision: bringing global best practices and institutional-quality investment expertise to Australian clients. This foundation enables the business to focus on delivering considered advice and expertise to clients across generations.

About The Role

LGT Bank is seeking experienced Business Analysts to join its growing Delivery function. These roles will support strategic change and mandatory initiatives across the business, helping turn business needs into well-defined requirements and practical solutions. You will work closely with business stakeholders, project managers, developers and testers to support delivery from early discovery and solution design through to testing and release.

Successful candidates will bring strong analytical and communication skills, an organised approach to delivery, and confidence working across multiple workstreams. Relevant project experience may include regulatory and compliance change, process optimisation, performance reporting, financial products, digital onboarding, data initiatives, or improvements that increase scale and efficiency in client-facing advisory environments. These opportunities are offered on 12-month fixed-term contracts.

Qualifications

A degree qualification is required. Candidates should have at least three years of Business Analyst experience, or five or more years of experience in wealth management with Business Analyst responsibilities. Experience working with wealth advisory or private banking platforms is important, and Avaloq experience is highly desirable. Strong knowledge of process mapping, Agile delivery and user story development is expected. Familiarity with wealth management products and services, the software development lifecycle (SDLC), and change methodologies will be advantageous.

Identify and implement process improvements that enhance NSO execution efficiency, predictability, and customer delivery performance.

Knowledge of manufacturing operations, change management, configuration management, and production planning processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

Wing provides drone delivery services designed to make last-mile logistics safer, faster, and more sustainable. The company designs, builds, and operates highly automated delivery aircraft that transport small packages directly from businesses to homes. Its technology is designed to integrate with existing delivery and logistics networks, supporting businesses across two continents.

Wing is part of Alphabet, Google's parent company, and is working to make drone delivery a preferred delivery solution worldwide.

About the Role

Wing is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join its Analytics team. This role can be based in Palo Alto, California, or performed remotely within the United States.

The Senior Data Analyst will use data and analytics to turn complex business questions into clear, actionable insights. The role involves analyzing large datasets, developing analytical models, conducting scenario analyses, and evaluating business tradeoffs to support strategic decisions.

The ideal candidate is solution-oriented, comfortable working with ambiguity, and able to communicate analytical findings through practical recommendations that help leadership make informed decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and meaningful business insights.
Identify appropriate data sources to address ambiguous business questions and ensure analyses are accurate and actionable.
Design and build analytical models to evaluate tradeoffs and quantify business impact.
Conduct scenario analyses and sensitivity testing to support strategic decision-making.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for business stakeholders.
Develop dashboards, automated workflows, and self-service analytics to make insights accessible and actionable.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to turn ambiguous challenges into well-defined analytical questions.
Support leadership decisions through data-driven analysis and effective communication.

Required Qualifications

3–6+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business analytics, consulting, or strategic data roles.
Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field, such as data analytics or mathematics.
Strong experience in data analysis, modeling, and applied analytics.
